sentences.text:
Criminal Petition No.4041 Of 2023
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioner/Accused No.3 to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.67 of 2023 of Station House Officer, Mahankali Police Station, Hyderabad.

The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 420, 406 and 468 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short "IPC").
2. Heard both sides.

3. After arguing sometime, learned counsel for the petitioner confines his prayer to direct the police to follow the procedure prescribed under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. for reason of the offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable less than seven (07) years.

4. In view of the aforesaid submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner, this Criminal Petition is disposed of directing the Investigating Officer in Crime No.67 of 2023 of Station House Officer, Mahankali Police Station, Hyderabad, to strictly follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. and also the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar1.
